name: WaterAsAResourceExtended
title: Water As A Resource Extended
author: DiabolicWolf
description: Turns water into a finite resource. Offshore pumps deplete waterbodies based on actual fluid extraction, with per-pump tracking. Water tiles 'dry out' as waterbodies deplete, starting from edges toward the center. Waterbodies slowly regenerate over time. Features: 6-tier Yield Boost research, Waterfill item to extend water, automatic waterbody merging/splitting, map markers with real-time stats, and configurable depletion alarms. Fully rewritten for Factorio 2.0 with improved performance, budget-limited updates, and proper multi-surface/multi-force support. Compatibility note: when CanalBuilderMAV is active, this mod's built-in waterfill is disabled automatically.
